questions.stem: A job must start whenever new files arrive in a Unity Catalog volume, at unpredictable times. Which trigger fits?
questions.explanation: A file arrival trigger starts a job run when new files arrive in a monitored Unity Catalog storage location, so the job runs when the data is there rather than on a clock.

questions.stem: A finance job must run at 06:00 every weekday, whether or not new data has arrived, because a report is due then. Which trigger fits?
questions.explanation: A scheduled trigger starts a job run based on a time-based schedule, which fits a deadline that doesn't depend on when data arrives.

questions.stem: A gold job should run only after its silver source tables have been updated by another team's pipeline. Which trigger reacts to that directly?

options.text: Scheduled, an hour after the other pipeline usually finishes

questions.explanation: A table update trigger starts a job run when source tables are updated, so a downstream job follows its data instead of guessing a time.

questions.stem: A streaming job must always be running, and a new run should start whenever a run completes or fails. Which trigger fits?
questions.explanation: A continuous trigger keeps the job always running by triggering another run whenever a run completes or fails.

questions.stem: A team adds a file arrival trigger and also clicks Run now while a run is already in progress. By default, how many runs of one job can be active at a time?

options.text: Two: one triggered and one manual

questions.explanation: By default, only a single run of a job can be active at a time.
